Viewers connect to the ingest city directly rather than to an edge, so keep large audiences on the default path. A viewer who joins between keyframes waits up to one keyframe interval for a picture. Takes effect on the next broadcast; HLS keeps working either way.

recording_store.description: PATCH only. Saving PROVES the bucket works: we write a test object under the prefix, read it back and delete it, and refuse the setting in one sentence if any of that fails.
